source: 552 Fake and Reality
target: 552 Falsum et Realitas

source: Lumian didn’t find the current Governor of the Sea’s plea for help surprising.
target: Lumian supplicationem gubernatoris maris hodierni ad auxilium petendum non invenit miram.

source: He raised his left hand and touched his ear.
target: Manum sinistram levavit et aurem tetigit.

source: In Intisian, he asked, “What are you saying? I only understand the word ‘help.'”
target: In Intisiano rogavit: “Quid dicis? Verbum ‘auxilium’ solum intelligo.”

source: The current Governor of the Sea, disguised as a woman, appeared dumbfounded, as if the language barrier was unexpected.
target: Gubernator Maris hodiernus, in habitu feminali tectus, apparuit attonitus, quasi discrimen linguae inopinatum esset.

source: Having racked his brains and risked his life to reach Louis Berry, the Governor of the Sea found himself unable to convey his request due to the language barrier!
target: Strenue meditabatur atque vitam suam periclitans ut Ludovicum Berry attingeret, gubernator Maris invenerat se ob discrimen linguae petitionem suam exprimere non posse!

source: Maintaining his pretense of not understanding Highlander, Lumian calmly took out a dark‑red fountain pen and a stack of post‑it notes, handing them over.
target: Se praetendens linguam Highlander non intellegere, Lumian tranquille extraxit calamus atroruberum et acervum schedarum adnotandarum, quos tradidit.

source: “Write down everything you want to say. I’ll get someone to translate it.”
target: “Scribe omnia quae dicere vis. Curabo ut aliquis ea interprete faciat.”

source: This time, he used Intisian again but gestured with the fountain pen to guide the other party on what to do.
target: Hoc tempore iterum Intisiano usus est, sed calamo atrorubro gestum dedit ut alteri indicaret quid faciendum esset.

source: If the Governor of the Sea is illiterate and unable to write Highlander, it would be troublesome…
target: Si gubernator Maris inliteratus esset et linguam Highlander scribere non posset, hoc molestum foret…

source: I would have to resort to communicating with individual words and body language.
target: Debebo ad verba singula et corporea signa communicanda recurrere.

source: I don’t want to reveal my knowledge of Highlander yet…
target: Nolo adhuc scientiam meam de lingua Highlander patefacere…

source: Lumian thought with concern.
target: Lumian cum sollicitudine cogitavit.

source: In Intis and Feynapotter, there were numerous illiterate individuals.
target: In Intis et Feynapotter multissimi inliterati erant.

source: The Governor of the Sea, after a brief moment of confusion, grasped Louis Berry’s intentions.
target: Gubernator Maris, post breve momentum confusionis, intensionem Ludovicum Berry intellexit.

source: He took the fountain pen and note and began scribbling.
target: Calamus atroruberus schedamque cepit et scribere coepit.

source: Lumian observed with a composed expression.
target: Lumian, vultu composito, observavit.

source: Despite being on the opposite side, with a Hunter’s vision and spatial imagination, he easily discerned the content of the written message:
target: Etsi in parte adversa versabatur, cum venatoris visione et spatii phantasia utebatur, facile intellexit contentum scripti nuntii:

source: “Please help me. Rescue me out of Port Santa! I’m not the true Governor of the Sea!”
target: “Quaeso, adiuva me! Eme me ex Portu Santa! Non sum verus gubernatoris maris!”

source: Not the true Governor of the Sea… Lumian suppressed the urge to raise his eyebrows and refrained from directly asking, maintaining an appearance of complete ignorance of the words.
target: Non verus gubernator Maris… Lumian impetum supercilium tollendi repressit et directe quaerere non ausus est, speciem omnino ignorantiae verborum servans.

source: He desired to see what additional information the current Governor of the Sea would reveal before considering his next set of questions.
target: Volebat videre quid additum gubernator Maris hodiernus revelaret, antequam alias interrogationes consideraret.

source: The man dressed in feminine attire paused for two seconds before continuing,
target: Vir, in habitu feminali indutus, duas secundas cessavit antequam perrexit,

source: “The true Governor of the Sea died during last year’s sea prayer ritual.”
target: “Verus gubernator Maris per ritum orationis maris anni praeteriti obiit.”

source: Dead? The genuine Governor of the Sea perished during the sea prayer ritual?
target: “Mortuus? Verus gubernator Maris in ritu orationis maris periit?”

source: Lumian felt a sudden surge of joy at this revelation.
target: Lumian subito impetum gaudii ob hanc revelationem sensit.

source: I can finally see the tail of the key members of April Fool’s!
target: Denique vestigia membrorum praecipuorum April Folliae conspicio!

source: One consequence of their prank last year was the predetermined Governor of the Sea’s failure to successfully perform the sea prayer ritual.
target: Una ex consequentiis ioci anni praeteriti fuit quod gubernator Maris praedefinitus ritu orationis maris feliciter perficiendo defecit.

source: He suffered a backlash from Beyonder powers and lost his life!
target: Ab potentibus Beyonder repulsus, vitam amisit!

source: This aligned with the revelations from Otta Guillaume, the Solow Motel owner, and his son, a government department clerk, regarding an increase in shipwrecks, a decline in fish harvests, and disrupted trade.
target: Hoc convenit cum revelationibus a Otta Guillaume, domino Solow Motel, et filio eius, schedario departmenti, de incremento naufragiorum, de deminutione piscum messium, et de commercio perturbato.

source: The imposter Governor of the Sea wrote swiftly, as if fearing someone might catch up to him at any moment.
target: Gubernator Maris impostor celeriter scribebat, quasi timebat aliquem eum omni momento assequi posse.

source: “I was chosen by Juan Oro and the Fisheries Guild to impersonate the Governor of the Sea for a year because I resemble the true Governor of the Sea.”
target: “A Juan Oro et Gildae Piscandi electus sum, ut per annum gubernatorem Maris impersonarem, quoniam verum gubernatorem Maris similem sum.”

source: This was to prevent fishermen and sea merchants from knowing about their grave mistake and the slip-up that caused the sea prayer ritual to fail.
target: Hoc erat ut piscatores et mercatores maris de grave errore et lapsu, qui ritu orationis maris defecerat, nescirent.

source: Such a failure has not occurred in recent centuries.
target: Talis defectus in annis recentibus non evenit.

source: Now that I know this secret, they won’t let me leave alive.
target: Iam, cum hoc secretum sciam, non sinent me vivo discedere.

source: After the Governor of the Sea handover ritual is completed and the vigil begins, I’ll undoubtedly be killed.
target: Postquam ritu traditionis gubernatoris Maris peractis erunt et vigilia incipient, certissime interfectus ero.

source: “I never wanted to play the role of Governor of the Sea.”
target: “Numquam volui munus gubernatoris Maris agere.”

source: It was a blasphemy against the sea, but they pointed a gun at me, claiming they had already killed someone who refused to cooperate.
target: Blasphemia erat contra mare, sed mihi telum intuebantur, dicentes se iam aliquem interfectum esse, qui cooperari recusaverat.

source: The Church and the government won’t intervene in the Fisheries Guild’s affairs.
target: Ecclesia Mater Terrae in negotiis internis Gildae Piscandi non immiscetur, nec gubernatio intercedet.

source: You’re the only one daring enough to infiltrate the Governor of the Sea’s residence and confront Juan Oro with a gun.
target: Tu solus es qui audeas in domicilium gubernatoris Maris irrumpere atque Juan Oro cum telum oppugnare.

source: I can only seek your help.
target: Solum auxilium tuum quaerere possum.

source: Over the past year, I’ve saved up quite a bit of money.
target: Per annum praeteritum multam pecuniam servavi.

source: I can give it all to you—
target: Omnia tibi dare possum—

source: 100,000 gold risot!
target: 100,000 risot aurei!

source: “I’ve heard about your recent exploits. I believe you have the strength. I implore you to help me!”
target: “Audivi de recentibus rebus tuis. Credo te vim habere. Rogo te, adiuva me!”

source: Quite educated… Lumian, after studying the three completed post‑it notes, sensed that the imposter Governor of the Sea differed from ordinary fishermen, vendors, or workers based on his grammar and vocabulary.
target: Lumian, postquam tres completas schedas notularum perlegit, sensit gubernatorem Maris impostorem ab ordinariis piscatoribus, mercatoribus, et operariis in grammatica et vocabulario differri.

source: Phew… After jotting down his reasons and request, the fake Governor of the Sea set aside the fountain pen and slid three post‑it notes filled with Highlander words to Lumian.
target: Fheu… Postquam causas ac petitionem sua scribebat, gubernator Maris impostor calamus stilum deponit et tres schedas notularum, verbis linguae Highlander impletas, Lumiano tradidit.

source: With a quick glance, Lumian contemplated using Highlander words and body language.
target: Cum celeriter intuitus esset, Lumian consilium cepit uti verbis linguae Highlander atque gestu corporali.

source: “Help? Your. Family?”
target: “Auxilium? Tua. Familia?”

source: The fake Governor of the Sea hastily wrote down a response: “My parents passed away a few years ago. I don’t have any other relatives. I was originally an employee of the Fisheries Company.”
target: Gubernator Maris impostor festinanter responsum scribebat: “Parentes mei paucis annis abhinc mortui sunt. Nullos alios cognatos habeo. Originarie operarius Societatis Piscandi fui.”

source: It’s no surprise Juan Oro and his associates dared to “kidnap” this person to be the Governor of the Sea.
target: Non mirum est quod Juan Oro et socii eius ausi sint hunc hominem “rapire” ut gubernatorem Maris fieret.

source: The Earth Mother Church refrains from meddling in the Fisheries Guild’s internal affairs.
target: Ecclesia Mater Terrae in negotiis internis Gildae Piscandi non immiscetur.

source: If it affects other citizens, they will still handle it…
target: Si alios cives afficiat, illud tamen curabunt…

source: Lumian pretended to ask first and planned to find someone later to translate the response.
target: Lumian simulavit se primum quaerere et postea aliquem invenire consilium ceperat, ut responsum interprete faceret.

source: “Servant girls. Pregnant?”
target: “Ancillae? Gravidæ?”

source: He inquired about the maids in the Governor of the Sea’s residence and the reason for their pregnancies.
target: Rogavit de ancillis in domicilio gubernatoris Maris et de causis eorum graviditatis.

source: The fake Governor of the Sea, concealed behind a blue veil, displayed no change in expression.
target: Gubernator Maris impostor, sub caeruleo velamine absconditus, nullam expressionis mutationem ostendit.

source: His right hand trembled slightly as he wrote: “The Governor of the Sea will receive the same treatment as the ruler of Port Santa.”
target: Manus dextra eius leviter tremuit dum scribebat: “Gubernator Maris eandem condicionem passurus est ac rector Portus Santa.”

source: He can do whatever he wants and directly visit them, enjoying the treatment an owner can receive.
target: Quidquid velit facere potest et eos directe visitare, fruens ratione tractationis quam dominus accipere potest.

source: I couldn’t help it.
target: Non potui me continere.

source: Observing this, Lumian nearly laughed aloud.
target: Observans hoc, Lumian paene alta voce risit.

source: Even in captivity, he’s focused on such matters?
target: Etiam in captivitate, an talibus rebus animum intendit?

source: Does he believe he can’t escape and is resigned to his imminent demise?
target: Creditne se effugere non posse et ad mortem imminere resignatum esse?

source: Is he seeking enjoyment while he still can?
target: Quaeritne voluptatem dum adhuc facultatem habet?

source: The fake Governor of the Sea added: “I can also tax those people and forcefully allocate their market share, but they will listen to me. However, I dare not go too far. Otherwise, Juan Oro will privately whip me with his cane and threaten to kill me.”
target: Gubernator Maris impostor addidit: “Possum etiam illos tributare et eorum mercatum vi coegerundum distribuere, sed me audient; tamen, non ultra procedere audeo; alioquin Juan Oro secreto me baculo flagellabit et me interficere minabitur.”

source: So, this is the source of your savings?
target: Ergo, hoc est fons tuarum pecuniarum servatarum?

source: Well, he can’t control the weather or the tides.
target: Bene, non potest caeli tempestatem neque aestus regere.

source: After all, he’s merely a false Governor…
target: Postremo, ipse solum falsus gubernator est…

source: Lumian took the fake Governor of the Sea’s new post‑it note and pondered for a moment before asking in a clumsy manner, “Original. Governor. Where?”
target: Lumian schedam notularum novam falsi gubernatoris Maris arripuit et paulo meditatus est antequam ineleganter quaesivit: “Originalis. Gubernator. Ubi?”

source: He inquired about the whereabouts of the former Governors of the Sea.
target: Interrogavit ubi veteres gubernatores Maris erant.

source: Noelia, the combat nun of the Fertility Order, hadn’t raised this issue before.
target: Noelia, monialis pugnax Ordinis Fertilitatis, hanc quaestionem antea non attulit.

source: It was unclear if she deemed it unimportant, chose not to disclose it for some reason, or lacked the corresponding information.
target: Incerto erat utrum eam neglegere arbitratus sit, sive de causa non divulgaverit, sive informatione adaequata caruerit.

source: The fake Governor of the Sea wrote: “I don’t know. I heard a maid from Milo Village mention it before. She’s Juan Oro’s granddaughter. She said that all the Governors of the Sea will eventually return to the sea.”
target: Gubernator Maris impostor scribebat: “Nescio. Audivi ancillam ex vico Milo prius id effari. Ea est nepos Juan Oro. Dixerat omnes gubernatores Maris tandem ad mare redire.”

source: Return to the sea… That doesn’t sound promising…
target: Redire ad mare… Id non pollice sonat…

source: Heh heh, designating Juan Oro’s granddaughter as your maid.
target: Heh heh, designans netam Juan Oro ut ancillam tuam.

source: Are you seeking revenge for the oppression from her grandfather?
target: Vultisne vindictam ferre propter iniuriam ab avo eius?

source: And Juan Oro agreed to it, indirectly retaliating by lashing you?
target: Et Juan Oro hoc assentiavit, indirecte te baculo flagellans retributisque?

source: Juan Oro and his sons are married to Maidens of the Sea, and there’s a chance his granddaughter is a lizard‑like monster…
target: Juan Oro et filii eius nuptos sunt cum Puellis Maris, et fortasse neta eius monstrum lacertiforme est…

source: How would you feel if you knew you were sleeping with a humanoid lizard?
target: Quomodo te sentires, si scires te cum lacerta humanoide cubitare?

source: Lumian criticized the fake Governor of the Sea internally.
target: Lumian gubernatorem Maris impostorem internis cogitationibus reprehendit.

source: He seemed to ponder for a moment, as if unable to comprehend the other party’s writing, and changed the question.
target: Videbatur paulisper meditari, quasi scripturam alterius intellegere non posset, et quaestionem mutavit.

source: “Juan Oro. Powerful?”
target: “Juan Oro. Potens?”

source: The fake Governor of the Sea suddenly shuddered.
target: Gubernator Maris impostor repente contremuit.

source: Swiftly, he wrote: “He’s very powerful. He’s a monster! He can suffocate people and cause them to die in pain!”
target: Celeriter scribebat: “Valde potens est. Monstrum est! Homines suffocare potest et eos in dolore mori facere!”

source: After writing this, the fake Governor of the Sea glanced at the sun outside the window.
target: Post hoc scribens, gubernator Maris impostor solem extra fenestram aspexit.

source: He set down the fountain pen, stood up, and bowed to Lumian.
target: Calamus stilum deponens, surrexit et Lumiano se inclinavit.

source: Then, swaying in his elegant dress, he made his way toward the café’s back door and departed.
target: Tum, in vestimento eleganti oscillante, ad posticam cauponae perrexit et discessit.

source: He appeared anxious about his “disappearance” during the shopping trip potentially raising suspicions from the bodyguards.
target: Apparuit anxius de sua “evanitione” in itinere mercandi, ne a custodibus suspectus fiat.

source: Lumian observed his departure, crumpling the post‑it notes into a ball in his palm.
target: Lumian eius discessum observavit, schedas notularum in manu sua in pilam congregans.

source: Crimson flames trickled from between his fingers before swiftly dissipating.
target: Flammae coccineae inter digitos eius stillabant, antequam celeriter evanuerent.

source: After sprinkling the ashes into the bottle with flowers, Lumian picked up the partially finished Torres coffee and took a sip.
target: Postquam cineres in amphoram cum floribus sparsi sunt, Lumian partim finitum caffeum Torres sustulit et parum biberat.

source: Lumian’s mind raced as he analyzed the information that concerned him the most.
target: Mens Lumiani festinanter currabat, dum informationes, quae eum maxime afficiebant, diligenter examinabat.

source: Is what the imposter said true?
target: Num id quod impostor dixit verum est?

source: Could an ordinary person find an opportunity to escape their bodyguards and approach me?
target: Potestne homo ordinarius occasionem invenire ut custodes suos effugiat et ad me accedat?

source: Is it possible that Juan Oro and the others secretly prompted him to set a trap for me, waiting for me to fall into it?
target: Num potest fieri ut Juan Oro et ceteri occulte eum impellerint ut mihi laqueum poneret, exspectantes ut in eum incidam?

source: During the April Fool’s prank, the specially crafted golden ring, lacking Beyonder powers, was concealed within the lamb’s body.
target: Inter iocum April Folliae, annulus aureus specialiter fabricatus, carens viribus Beyonder, in corpore agni celatus est.

source: The lamb was taken as a sacrifice on the Governor of the Sea’s ship…
target: Agnus pro sacrificio in nave gubernatoris Maris sublatus est…

source: Is April Fool’s meant to substitute something with this ring?
target: Num April Follia hoc annulo aliquid substituere intendit?

source: Is there another sacrificial ring similar to it?
target: Estne alius annulus sacrificii similis huic?

source: Did the Governor of the Sea’s appointment fail last year because the crucial sacrificial ring turned out to be a fake and couldn’t be utilized?
target: Num constitutio gubernatoris Maris anno praeterito defecit, quia annulus sacrificii praecipuus falsus esse apparuit et adhiberi non potuit?

source: This implies that key members of April Fool’s or their subordinates are on the special ship.
target: Hoc significat quod membra praecipua April Folliae aut subditi eorum in nave speciali adsint.

source: Otherwise, they wouldn’t have been able to deceive the committee members of the Fisheries Guild and surreptitiously replace important items…
target: Alioquin membris consilii Gildae Piscandi decipere et res maximas clandestine substituere non potuissent…

source: Based on the information I’ve gathered, there aren’t many sailors on that ship.
target: Ex informationibus congregatis, pauci nautae in illa nave adsunt.

source: The only passengers are the Governor of the Sea, four Maidens of the Sea, and a few individuals guiding them through the ritual.
target: Vectores unici sunt gubernator Maris, quattuor Puellae Maris, et paucī qui eos per ritu dirigunt.

source: Who among them is connected to April Fool’s?
target: Quis inter eos ad April Follia pertineat?

source: The Fisheries Guild must have conducted an investigation afterward.
target: Gildae Piscandi postea inquisitionem egisse oportet.

source: I wonder if they’ve drawn any conclusions…
target: Miror num conclusiones aliquas extraxerint…

source: I can’t dismiss the possibility that the deceased Governor of the Sea is linked to April Fool’s.
target: Non possum possibilitatem negare quod gubernator Maris defunctus ad April Follia coniungatur.

source: Maybe he was completely deceived, thinking that by changing the ring and causing the ritual to fail, he could avoid returning to the sea like the previous Governors of the Sea.
target: Forsitan plane deceptus est, putans quod annulum mutando et ritu deficendo redire ad mare, sicut gubernatores Maris pristini, vitari posset.

source: However, Bard, Mad Lady, and Ultraman may not have cared about his life at all…
target: Attamen Bard, Mad Lady, et Ultraman fortasse penitus de vita eius non curaverunt.

source: What’s the purpose of April Fool’s? Is it merely a prank for their own amusement, or does it harbor a deeper motive?
target: Quid est propositum April Folliae? Num solum iocus ad ipsorum voluptatem est, an altior finis insidet?

source: Ordinary April Fool’s members might engage purely for entertainment.
target: Membra ordinaria April Folliae fortasse solum ad delectationem se conferant.

source: As for the key members, truth and lies are invariably intertwined…
target: Quoad membra praecipua, veritas et mendacia inextricabiliter inter se sunt.

source: Sitting in the café until the sun neared the horizon, Lumian donned the straw hat and leisurely made his way back to the Solow Motel.
target: Sedens in caupona usque ad horizontem solis, Lumian pileum stramineum induit et ad Solow Motel lente rediit.

source: Late at night, Lugano returned from the bar, emanating the scent of alcohol.
target: Sero nocte, Lugano ex taberna rediit, efferens odorem alcoholis.

source: He approached Lumian and said,
target: Ad Lumian accedens, dixit:

source: “I’ve inquired with adventurers and bounty hunters about Batna and his lover. They all claim not to have seen them in the past few days. As soon as they arrived at Port Santa, it was as if they vanished.”
target: “Interrogavi cum adventoribus et venatoribus praemiatorum de Batna et amator eius. Omnes affirmant se eos paucis diebus praeteritis non vidisse. Statim, quo Portum Santa advenissent, quasi evanuerunt.”

source: Vanished? Nolfi, being the child of a Maiden of the Sea, wouldn’t be so clandestine if she were merely returning to Port Santa and the Fisheries Guild…
target: Evanuerunt? Nolfi, cum filia Puellae Maris sit, non ita occultē ageret, si solum ad Portum Santa et Gildam Piscandi rediret…

source: Could she be involved in something related to the sea prayer ritual and convinced Batna to join her?
target: Num illa in aliquo, quod ad ritu orationis Maris pertinet, implicata sit et Batnam ad se conciliaret?

source: Yet, they were targeted upon their return?
target: At, redierunt, et illi quasi scopum electi sunt?

source: Perhaps she possesses significant knowledge… I can’t personally search for them right now.
target: Forsitan ipsa notitiam amplam possidet… Ego eos nunc personaliter quaerere non possum.

source: I need to be more visible as an adventurer…
target: Mihi opus est ut adventor magis conspicuus sim.

source: Lugano isn’t the most reliable source…
target: Lugano non est fons maxime fidus.

source: What about Noelia, the nun?
target: Quid de Noelia, monialis?

source: A flurry of speculations raced through Lumian’s mind.
target: Multae speculationes celeriter per mentem Lumiani transierunt.

source: As his thoughts raced, he suddenly realized the kind of assistance he should seek from the Knight of Swords.
target: Dum cogitationes eius festinanter currabant, subito intellexit quod genus auxilii a Eques Ensis quaerendum esset.
